+title: 'Nested runs: the agents tool in a run, finish after children, delivery turns, maxDepth'
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §8 step 7, §9.3 (children, depth). M5, second part.
+
+- In `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun.swift`, pass an `agentsTool` closure to `ToolResolver` that makes a new `AgentsTool` with `AgentsTool.make(context:)` for this run, limited by `Agent(a, b)`. The child is started with this run's session as the caller.
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Run/AgentRun+Children.swift`:
+  - The run records the runs that it started.
+  - After its task turn, while a child is open or a post is unread, the run waits. Each time a child finishes, the run calls `session.dispatchNextPrompt()`; the Router runs one turn with the staged posts. The model can start more children.
+  - A run that waits for children holds no concurrency slot. A delivery turn never checks the limit.
+  - When no child is open and no post is unread, the text of the last turn is the result.
+  - A cancel, or a failure with open children, cancels the children, waits for their tasks, then closes the session and posts.
+- Depth: a host-started run has depth 1; a child has its parent's depth plus 1. Above `maxDepth` `start agent` gives a corrective.
+- Model `inherit` in a child uses the slot of the calling run.
+- `check agent` running text adds "It waits for `N` agents that it started." after its turn.
+- Verify (plan.md §16): `dispatchNextPrompt()` with a staged `.completed` runs one turn; with nothing staged it gives `nil`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A scripted `lead` starts `code-reviewer` and `test-writer`, reads both posts in delivery turns, and its final text holds both results.
+- [ ] The parent finishes only after its children.
+- [ ] A failing parent cancels its open children first, then posts.
+- [ ] With `maxConcurrentAgents` 2, two waiting siblings hold no slot and their children start.
+- [ ] `maxDepth` 2: a grandchild start gives the corrective.
+- [ ] A child with no `model` runs on the `flash` slot when its parent is on `flash`.
+- [ ] `agentSpawn` links three sessions, and `parentToolCallId` equals the `start agent` completion token.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/NestedRunTests.swift` covers each criterion.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter NestedRunTests`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+    ### Research
+    - `RoutedSession.dispatchNextPrompt() async throws -> String?` gives the text of the delivery turn, or nil when nothing is staged. It is the only delivery API. Its turn gives no `SessionEvent` stream to the run, so `lastEvent` does not change in a delivery turn.
+    - A child posts its final message before it sets its final state. Thus a parent that sees the final state of a child knows that the post is staged.
+    - Design: each run holds `AgentRunChildren` (a Mutex list plus an `AsyncStream<Void>` of child endings). A child adds itself to the list of its parent in `AgentRun.start`, before its turn starts, and signals the parent after `end(in:)`. There is no unstructured watcher task.
+    - The agents tool of a run gets `ParentRun` (depth, slot, children) through `AgentsToolContext`. `start agent` gives the child the depth of the parent plus 1, and the slot of the parent for `inherit`. A root session that is not a run gives `hostDepth` and `defaultSlot`.
+    - DECISION: `startWithinLimit` does not count the calling run. Reason: with limit 2, sibling A has its turn in operation when it starts its child, and sibling B is running too. If the caller counts, the first child start of A sees 2 working runs and fails, so the criterion "two waiting siblings hold no slot and their children start" cannot pass. The calling run waits for the child after its turn and then holds no slot (plan.md §9.3), so the start does not count it.
+    - The delivery loop waits for a child ending before each dispatch while a child is open. Thus a parent is not in a delivery turn (a working run) while its only child still works.
